variantInfo.name: Skeleton
notes: NPC id 74 (level 21); 24 Hitpoints, Defence 17, max hit 3 crush.
Undead: Salve amulet and the crush weakness (crush -5) apply; 35% weakness to earth spells.
Wilderness skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows count for Krystilia's task.

variantInfo.name: Skeleton
notes: Level 21/22 skeletons (NPC ids 74, 70) in non-Wilderness dungeons for the starter masters.
Same undead category; count for Turael/Spria/Mazchna Skeletons tasks but not Krystilia.

locationComparison.name: Graveyard of Shadows (skeletons)
notes: Wilderness skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows (levels 18-21) for Krystilia.
The wiki Wilderness skeletons row lists this as multicombat and cannonable; it is not safespottable.
High-risk PvP zone: bring risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport.

locationComparison.name: Non-Wilderness skeletons
notes: Edgeville Dungeon and the Varrock Sewers hold skeletons for the starter masters.
Both areas are cannonable per the wiki; Edgeville Dungeon is single-way and safespottable, while the Varrock Sewers are multicombat.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 271 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Skeletons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100) plus Turael/Spria (15-30) and Mazchna (30-50) starter masters all assign skeletons.
Skeletons are undead, so the Salve amulet applies; they are weakest to crush melee (crush -5) and have a 35% earth spell weakness.
Krystilia's task counts only Wilderness skeleton kills (e.g. the Graveyard of Shadows).
graveyard-of-shadows base file is owned by the zombies family (CT-L shared #3); this family uses a tuned copy while that owner file is not yet on disk.
recommendedMethod: Skeletons are undead, so wear a Salve amulet (or Salve amulet (ei)) and hit their crush weakness with a crush weapon; any melee clears them quickly given their low defence, and earth spells exploit the 35% earth weakness for Magic training. For Krystilia, kill Wilderness skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; starter masters can be finished safely in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers.
